rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: The Presidency's text of Mbeki's address on the occasion of his inauguration, Pretoria, 27 April 2004, says the day marks Freedom Day and the inauguration of the President of the Republic; Speaker Baleka Mbete and Chief Justice Arthur Chaskalson are among those addressed.
